correctness.rationale: The angular generator on the circle has a simple isolated zero eigenvalue at zero tilt; Feynman–Kac gives an analytic scaled cumulant eigenvalue phi. Its left Fourier moments satisfy (q+n²+phi)a_n=q+(z/2)(a_{n-1}+a_{n+1}), phi=z a_1. For coefficient of z^6, only n+j<=6 appear, so the rational recurrence is an exact perturbative coefficient and not a Fourier truncation. Reconstructed rational numerator P and positive denominator, independently substituted five rational q and verified Descartes gives two positive roots counted with multiplicity; exact sign brackets on (1/4,13/50) and (29/20,3/2) force two distinct simple roots. Gaussian translation only contributes D_T k² and therefore no sixth cumulant.
